Bijective mapping of 2026 British GP event roles {HARD->C1, MEDIUM->C2, SOFT->C3} onto the official nominated three-compound set.

Shared 2026 Pirelli P Zero dry slick physical compound catalogue (homologated 15 Dec 2025). Contains verified physical compound identities and hardness ranks; uncalibrated model coefficients are preserved as null (UNKNOWN_UNAVAILABLE) pending the calibration task.
Master provenance register documenting exact URLs, publication/effective dates, retrieval timestamps, derivations, and licensing caveats for all 11 sources.
Comprehensive research, data-status, conflict-resolution, missing-data, and validation report for the 2026 Silverstone dataset batch.
